The `DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS` row changes from "Not forwarded to LaunchAgents" to "Forwarded to the launchd provider job". No code is changed in the supplied evidence. The claimed forwarding behavior (the LaunchAgent passthrough allow-list) lives in a source file that is not supplied, so I cannot verify it.

Security relevance: this relates to T-041 (SSD prefix cache, A-001) and, indirectly, TB-003. The variable can only disable delta checkpoint writing (negative spellings) and defaults to on. Forwarding it lets an operator's rollback reach installed daemons. It does not loosen the TTL, disk budget, HMAC lookup tags, AAD construction, DBK3 crypto, or the per-donation gate. The T-041 detection_hint names those as the surfaces needing a fresh sign-off, and none is altered here.

One point for integration: if the code change (not in this batch) adds the variable to `LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys`, check that delta checkpoints keep the same HMAC-only naming, AAD binding and KEK protection as full files. That is a code-review question and not a finding on this docs-only diff. Line 683 still says the STAGE variables are not forwarded, and the doc at 545/562 describes other non-forwarded sets. I found no inconsistency in those that bears on security.
